dct_title_s: Building Damage Assessment in Black River Village, Saint Elizabeth Parish as of 29 October 2025
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: TC20251026HTI, GDACS ID: 1001230** This map illustrates structures and buildings damaged by Tropical Cyclone MELISSA-25. The analysis focuses on Black River Village, Saint Elizabeth Parish, as of 29 October 2025. Damage and destruction were identified using a WorldView-2 very high-resolution satellite image acquired on 29 October 2025. UNOSAT identified approximately 314 destroyed and 1,183 damaged buildings. This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Ground verification is encouraged, and feedback can be sent to the United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).
